g08_previous_boundary: Existing compare and emphasis-state panels are useful, but their graph/version semantics do not directly express arbitrary editorial panels with shared positions. The study did not implement or test a template system.
g08_current_boundary: Existing compare and emphasis-state panels are useful, but their graph/version semantics do not directly express arbitrary editorial panels with shared positions. In particular, native state declarations and inspect --states already draw labeled panels from one layout and can fade nonfocused objects; compare already aligns before/after version panels. E09's rejected state=muted node attribute is an authoring error, not evidence that focus or dimming is absent. The study did not exhaustively evaluate those existing panel paths or implement a template system, so assess their applicability before adding new shared-geometry syntax.
